concepts.name: Whole-ship cutaway
concepts.prompt:
Using the attached approved ship exterior as an EDIT TARGET, make a coherent architectural dollhouse CUTAWAY of this SAME exact ship, not a redesigned exterior. Retain its asymmetric proportions, blue projecting port cockpit/hab hull, shorter cream cargo hull, external rear engines, landing feet, front cargo ramp and color blocking. Remove the roofs and selected upper side walls to show ALL single-deck rooms at once from high front three-quarter above. Clearly show connected floor surfaces and real internal doors, an enclosed cross-connection from rear of living cabin to cargo/engineering, keep exterior silhouette identifiable. White quiet background; readable large landscape concept plate. Tiny unobtrusive room callouts outside hull ONLY: Cockpit, Living hab, Wet bath, Cargo, Engineering. Do not label furniture or use dimensions on art. Include one scale person. Fine ink Moebius-inspired painted science-fiction illustration in the approved game style, restrained matte cream and blue color fields, warm golden practical light and crisp cool blue shadows, cassette-futurist CRTs and tactile controls, rounded chamfers and few precise service seams, subtle wear not filthy, no photorealism, no text on every object, no HUD, no collage. Comfortable small working home, every object purposeful.
FIXED SPATIAL BRIEF for the approved OUTRIGGER asymmetric small starter ship. Exterior reference is authoritative: longer blue port hull with projecting angular cockpit, shorter cream starboard cargo hull starting 3m behind the nose, joined at rear-middle by enclosed cross-passage, engines aft. Provisional outer size 14m long x 8m wide including fittings, ONE deck. Port clear width 2.7m, clear headroom 2.2m. From nose aft: 2.3m cockpit, then 4.0m combined living room, then 1.7m service zone with compact 1.2x1.5m wet bath outboard and walkable junction inboard, then machinery/tanks aft behind bulkhead. Living room: 2.0x0.85m longitudinal bunk against port/outboard wall beneath the existing exterior hab window; drawers below and overhead lockers. Opposite bunk against inboard wall a compact 1.9m galley (fridge, oven, sink, water dispenser), then a small 0.7m folding dining table and fixed seat toward aft; a small CRT daily-checklist terminal with printer beside dining spot. Maintain continuous approximately 0.9m central aisle, no room bigger on inside than hull. Enclosed 1.0m-clear-width transverse passage at service zone joins cream hull. Cream hull clear width 2.8m: forward ramp opens to 1.3m-deep entry/airlock, then a 3.8m cargo room with modest wall racks and unobstructed center aisle, shallow temporary staging pads separate from racks, cargo-lock switch; aft service/engineering zone with sensor CRT and reachable removable machinery panels; separate aft sealed drive/fuel compartment. No second deck, no extra bedroom, no vast lounge, no wide corridors. All measurements provisional design targets to validate in Blender later.
